study: Channel covariance and fault-preserving scheduler seeds
build: Release with CLIFFT_FORCE_ASSERTS=ON and OpenMP enabled
scope: Compiler-only native study; no registered pass or default, HIR, planner or executor change. Five noisy examples and ten existing workloads, not a full noisy-corpus scan.

method.reordered: PeepholeFusionPass, reordering, PeepholeFusionPass, PhasePolynomialPass, StatevectorSqueezePass, ActiveWidthSchedulePass
method.covariance: Equal probabilities for each anticommuting Pauli pair R and i*A*R. Unsigned bodies, exact floating equality, conservative sufficient criterion for all rotation angles.
method.channel_semantics: Clear original logical-noise prefixes: preserve averaged channel and fault-count-conditioned distributions; individually labelled Pauli fault paths may change.
method.labelled_semantics: Materialize and permute original logical-noise prefixes with operations: existing planner sign corrections preserve every labelled fault realization. Fusion and phase rewrites guard nonredundant prefixes.
method.movements: Rotate only T or arbitrary-angle Pauli rotations across eligible noise and commuting rotations; stop at every other operation. Noise-site order retained.
method.noise: Independent one- or two-qubit depolarizing noise p=0.001 after every primitive unitary gate, with ideal measurement/reset gadgets, identical to prior gate_depolarizing model.
method.postselection: Use CSV mask or existing workload detector mask, with raw detector signs.
method.sampling: Native sample_survivors, threads=1, batch_size=1, warmup and calibration toward 0.2 seconds capped at 200000 shots, five alternating repeats, seeds 20261001 through 20261005.
method.throughput: Median seconds per attempted shot, compilation and warmup excluded. Expensive baseline 1037 uses five shots per repeat.
method.compile_timing: One measurement per arm; source parse and trace and the HIR argument copy excluded. Timing is indicative, not a repeated compile benchmark.
method.costs: HIR dense work does not model prepared fused rotations; lowered_lane_work is the existing executable coefficient-visit estimate for aggregate survivors, not a hardware timing model.
method.oracle: Aer density-matrix joint records; exhaustive native replay by noise outcome and record string also checks each labelled path and each fault-count bucket. Small oracle only, not the throughput algorithm.
method.collection: Preserve rotation order, collecting each commuting block before pending noise whenever every crossed channel commutes with the moving rotation. Compare averaged and labelled semantics, and averaged semantics with phase-variable caps 32 and 64.

validation.coverage: One- and two-qubit depolarizing noise, Clifford-conjugated support, biased and asymmetric Pauli channels, arbitrary angles, intermediate records and feedback. Channel-only rewrite has a labelled-path discrepancy of 0.5 in a witness; all labelled variants preserve path probabilities. Both block-collection variants are included in the joint and labelled-path checks.

summary.conclusion: Covariance does not recover the one-coordinate phase core under full gate-depolarizing noise in these examples. Strong partial gains can be reproduced within current fault-preserving scheduling. Rotation order also exposes prepared executor fusion on quantum-volume workloads. Use full-pipeline candidate comparison and a fusion-aware cost objective; no default-enabling claim.
summary.collection: Circuits 0005, 0300 and 1037 collect their T gates into one block under averaged-channel semantics, but exceed both phase-variable caps 32 and 64. The other two remain bounded. No T or peak reduction. This identifies a limitation of provable fixed signed entry relations, not a lower bound on noisy sampling cost.
